release_notes.en: Console flash fix, take two: added STARTUPINFO+SW_HIDE alongside CREATE_NO_WINDOW. Video Studio's moviepy -> imageio_ffmpeg -> platform.win32_ver chain was leaking a cmd.exe flash through the shell=True wrapper; now double-suppressed.
release_notes.tr: Konsol flaş düzeltmesi, ikinci tur: CREATE_NO_WINDOW'a ek olarak STARTUPINFO+SW_HIDE eklendi. Video Studio'nun moviepy -> imageio_ffmpeg -> platform.win32_ver zinciri shell=True üzerinden cmd.exe flaşı sızdırıyordu; artık çift katmanlı engelleniyor.
